rationale: AD-319 and epic #880, PR 4.1b-3, against origin/main 57e2542f. The memory limit and the reply checks leave process.py, which falls below 500 lines (AD-314). Two modules join the process component through exact_modules: analyzer.memory_limit (the RLIMIT_AS call and the exit text) and analyzer.reply_checks (the checks of a reply that moved from process.py without change). The three allowed type ignores keep their text. Only their lines move: windows_job._create_owned_job 60 to 66, process.is_process_alive 479 to 392 and 491 to 404. No public name, budget, baseline entry or Any permission changes.
